quests.title: The Sun Rises Once More

dialogue.t: Why, of course. I owe you both my thanks — this lighthouse looks a fair sight better now that it's being maintained.
Hehe, our pleasure! Although, it seems like even with a functioning lighthouse, this whole place is still really dark. There are some places the light doesn't even reach.
Indeed. In the graveyard, it seemed as if even time itself had forever paused at the close of the battle that night.
I never had any intention of changing this, but it seems that by lighting the lighthouse, you have set time in motion once again.
If you mean to ask whether I shall be inconvenienced in any way, the answer is no.
Life comes in cycles. Even without us, the ghosts that linger here would slowly disappear and return to the Ley Lines.
So do not worry that this lighthouse cannot shine upon every last corner of the island. As the ghosts gradually leave, so too will the fog that envelops the area.

quests.description: The sun will always pierce the darkness and shine hope down…
